name: Fronius non-Hybrid Datamanager, float mode, models 113 + 160
address_convention: zero-based protocol addresses. Fronius register number minus 1; the SunS marker is at address 40000 (FRO-OI p.18).
unit_id_note: Site-configured. Inverter number 01 maps to unit ID 001, number 00 maps to 100. Meter is 240, string controls from 101, sensor cards from 245 (FRO-OI p.16-17). Example value.
function_codes_source: FRO-OI p.7: 03 read holding, 06 write single, 16 write multiple
session_notes: Queries should run sequentially with a timeout of at least 10 s (FRO-OI p.15). Control writes can be restricted by source IP in the web interface (FRO-OI p.30).

documents.FRO-OI: Official HTML operating instructions https://manuals.fronius.com/html/4204102049/en-US.html. Earlier v3 page citations refer to its mirrored PDF edition.
documents.FRO-MAP: Retrieved 2026-11-11 from https://www.fronius.com/QR-link/0006. Inverter_Register_Map_Float_v1.0_with_SYMOHYBRID_MODEL_124.xlsx, Complete Map. SHA256 993e43a66e4e5db27f148e8d46d5c2a1920fd5b375ddf6887c81d8956f4ea273.
documents.SEC-OEM: openenergymonitor.org forum transcription of the Fronius float map ('from docs'). Secondary source.

evidence.basis: FRO-MAP Complete Map row 39, printed registers converted to zero-based addresses. DC energy and its scale factor excluded on Fronius Hybrid inverters.

DCWH_1.semantic: DC lifetime energy of MPPT input 1 (string 1)

evidence.basis: FRO-MAP Complete Map row 192, printed registers converted to zero-based addresses. DC energy and its scale factor excluded on Fronius Hybrid inverters.

DCWH_SF.semantic: scale factor for DC lifetime energy

evidence.basis: FRO-MAP Complete Map row 183, printed registers converted to zero-based addresses. DC energy and its scale factor excluded on Fronius Hybrid inverters.

hazards: FRO-OI p.18: register addresses do not remain constant. Find the model by request, then use offsets.
FRO-OI p.31-32: register F_ModelType (number 216, address 215) switches float and int+SF. All later model addresses then shift. Writable over Modbus.
FRO-OI p.21: an unsupported acc32 reads as 0, the same as a real zero.
